title: INTERNATIONAL BATTERY METALS LTD. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: International Battery Metals Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026 announcing a non-brokered private placement financing of USD $2.8 million with insider EV Metals VII LLC, controlled by director Jacob Warnock. Each unit consists of one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.15 for four years, priced at USD $0.08 per unit. The offering is expected to close on or around April 24, 2026, subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.
key_points: Company announced USD $2.8 million non-brokered private placement with EV Metals VII LLC (insider controlled by director Jacob Warnock)
Units priced at USD $0.08 each; each unit includes one common share and one warrant
Warrants entitle holder to purchase one additional common share at C$0.15 per share for four years
Offering expected to close on or around April 24, 2026 pending TSX Venture Exchange approval
Company will pay Jacob Warnock a 5% structuring fee on gross proceeds, payable in cash at closing
Units subject to four-month plus one-day hold period under Canadian securities laws
